item.title: The Lynk & Co 900 wants to set ablaze the premium competition
item.description: When Lynk & Co first entered the Philippine market, it initially targeted a youthful crowd looking for a practical, stylish lineup of vehicles. But now, under the Geely Motor Philippines umbrella, the Chinese brand with Swedish ties asks: “What if we could target the premium market?”
